# Forward render API

<div class="doc-meta"><span class="doc-badge">Reference</span> Generated from <code>src/caffeine/script/api/forwardrender.json</code></div>

Per-entity forward renderer features: instancing, image-based lighting, occlusion, reflections and volumetrics.

<!-- Generated by caffeine-website/scripts/generate-api-pages.py. Edit the engine JSON instead. -->

## Functions

### `caffeine.forwardrender.ensure`

`ensure(entity) -> boolean`

Adds the forward-render features component to the entity if missing. The setters below do nothing without it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — false if the entity is invalid.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.forwardrender.ensure(cam)
```

### `caffeine.forwardrender.setInstancing`

`setInstancing(entity, enabled, maxBatch)`

Configures GPU instancing.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |
| `enabled` | boolean | Turns the feature on or off. |
| `maxBatch` | number | Maximum instances per batch. Optional. |

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.forwardrender.setInstancing(cam, true, 256)
```

### `caffeine.forwardrender.setIbl`

`setIbl(entity, enabled, diffuse, specular)`

Configures image-based lighting.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |
| `enabled` | boolean | Turns the feature on or off. |
| `diffuse` | number | Diffuse strength. Optional. |
| `specular` | number | Specular strength. Optional. |

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.forwardrender.setIbl(cam, true, 1.0, 1.0)
```

### `caffeine.forwardrender.setOcclusion`

`setOcclusion(entity, enabled)`

Turns occlusion on or off.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |
| `enabled` | boolean | Turns the feature on or off. |

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.forwardrender.setOcclusion(cam, true)
```

### `caffeine.forwardrender.setReflections`

`setReflections(entity, enabled, mode)`

Configures reflections and their mode.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |
| `enabled` | boolean | Turns the feature on or off. |
| `mode` | number | 0 Off, 1 Planar, 2 ScreenSpace, 3 Probe; clamped to 0..3. Optional. |

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.forwardrender.setReflections(cam, true, 2)
```

### `caffeine.forwardrender.setVolumetrics`

`setVolumetrics(entity, enabled, quality)`

Configures volumetric fog and its quality.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |
| `enabled` | boolean | Turns the feature on or off. |
| `quality` | number | 0 Off, 1 Low, 2 Medium, 3 High; clamped to 0..3. Optional. |

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.forwardrender.setVolumetrics(cam, true, 2)
```
